name: File Creation Date Changed to Another Year
description:
Attackers may change the file creation time of a backdoor to make it look like it was installed with the operating system.
Note that many processes legitimately change the creation time of a file; it does not necessarily indicate malicious activity.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Changes made to or by the local NTP service
query: ((winlog.event_data.PreviousCreationUtcTime:2022* AND (NOT winlog.event_data.CreationUtcTime:2022*)) OR (winlog.event_data.PreviousCreationUtcTime:202* AND (NOT winlog.event_data.CreationUtcTime:202*))) AND (NOT (((process.executable:(C\:\\Windows\\system32\\ProvTool.exe OR C\:\\Windows\\System32\\usocoreworker.exe OR C\:\\Windows\\ImmersiveControlPanel\\SystemSettings.exe)) OR file.path:C\:\\ProgramData\\USOPrivate\\UpdateStore\\* OR (file.path:(*.tmp OR *.temp))) OR (process.executable:C\:\\WINDOWS\\* AND process.executable:*\\TiWorker.exe AND file.path:*.cab)))
